_doc: SEASON-005: the village elder's seasonal tasks. seasons: {spring|summer|autumn|winter: {tasks: [exactly 3 {id (globally unique), text (non-empty), kind, target, count (int 1..5)}], payout: {stones (int >= 0), renown (int >= 0, in Qingshi Village), favor_all (int >= 0, favor with every villager of Qingshi Village), item (optional items.json id, one given)}}}. kind: catch (target = an items.json fish id; counts fish caught), gather (target = an items.json id; counts units gathered or foraged), hunt (target = an enemies.json id; counts wins), contest (target = a world_events.json id with a contest; counts entries), sell_wanted (target ''; counts units sold to a market's wanted-item bonus). Progress lives in CharacterData.season_tasks and resets when the season changes; SeasonTasks.note adds to it and pays the reward once when all three are done.

tasks.text: Land a Peach-Blossom Bream from the village pond.
Gather 3 Peach Blossom Petals for the shrine.
Drive off a Fog-Antler Stag that is trampling the fields.
Land a Lotus Bass from the forest pond.
Gather 2 Qi Condensing Grass for the elder's tonic.
Race in the Dragon Boat Festival.
Land a Maple Roach for the harvest table.
Hunt a Mist Fox that raids the granaries.
Sell 2 of a stall's wanted goods at the market.
Land an Ice Perch for the winter feast.
Hunt a Den Wolf that prowls near the village.
